nodes.title: Python Foundations
nodes.description: Master the language: variables, data types, control flow, functions, and OOP. This is your launchpad — everything else builds on it.

nodes.title: Data Analysis
nodes.description: Learn to work with data at scale using NumPy arrays and Pandas DataFrames. Essential for every data role.

nodes.title: Machine Learning Basics
nodes.description: Understand supervised and unsupervised learning, train your first models, and evaluate them properly.

nodes.title: Deep Learning
nodes.description: Neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs for images, and RNNs/Transformers for sequences.

nodes.title: NLP & Text
nodes.description: Process and understand natural language — tokenization, embeddings, sentiment analysis, and text classification.

nodes.title: LLMs & Prompt Engineering
nodes.description: Work with large language models via APIs. Master prompt engineering, structured outputs, and context management.

nodes.title: Agentic AI
nodes.description: Build autonomous AI agents with tools, memory, and multi-agent orchestration. The frontier of AI engineering.
